results.content:
What gets builders searching for alternatives is usually one of two things: the visual workflow editor becomes hard to navigate once an app has dozens of interlinked flows, or the builder wants to eventually own portable code instead of an app that only runs inside Bubble’s proprietary runtime. Both are legitimate reasons — neither means Bubble is broken. They just point toward a different kind of tool.

The five alternatives below split roughly into three approaches: other visual/low-code platforms (Retool, Airtable), AI code generators that emit a frontend from a chat prompt (Lovable, Bolt), and a product agent that compiles a full-stack app from a spec (Remy).

## How Do Retool and Airtable Compare to Bubble? [...] ## What’s a Good Alternative to Bubble for a Real Backend?

Bubble is a mature visual builder with its own hosted database, workflow engine, and plugin ecosystem — it’s not missing a backend. The reason builders look for alternatives is usually the drag-and-drop editor itself: workflows get tangled as an app grows, and every change happens by clicking through a canvas rather than describing the change in words. The five tools below take different approaches to that same job, from other visual builders to code-generating AI tools to Remy, which starts from a plain-language spec and turns it into a deployed full-stack app with generated TypeScript you own.

## TL;DR [...] Can I export my app from Bubble and run it elsewhere? Bubble apps run inside Bubble’s platform and aren’t designed to be exported as standalone source code. If code portability matters, a code-generating alternative is the better fit.

Is Lovable or Bolt a good Bubble alternative? Both generate real frontend code from a chat prompt, which is a step up from a pure visual canvas. Their backend and auth commonly run on third-party infrastructure, and iteration happens through more prompts rather than a single spec you recompile.

#### Pricing

Glide has a free version that gets you familiar with its system. Pricing starts at $60/month to get the ability to build an app with a custom domain, but it is still limited by app updates and data record rows, which attract additional charges. Glide does not support Apple App Store or Google Play Store publishing—your apps remain web-only.

#### Final Verdict

Glide is the Bubble alternative for building quick, template-based web apps. However, the template restrictions limit creative freedom, and the lack of native mobile app publishing is a significant constraint. If you need true native iOS and Android apps with unlimited customization and no record limits, Adalo offers more flexibility at a lower starting price point. [...] ## Making Your Choice

Each Bubble alternative serves different needs. Softr and Glide work well for quick spreadsheet-based web apps, though both lack native mobile app publishing and have data restrictions. Webflow excels at websites but isn't built for app development. Betty Blocks serves enterprises with specific compliance requirements and budgets to match.

For most app builders seeking an alternative to Bubble's complexity, unpredictable pricing, and web-wrapper mobile approach, Adalo offers the most complete solution: AI-assisted building, true native iOS and Android apps from a single codebase, unlimited database records on paid plans, and predictable pricing without usage-based surprises.

## FAQ

### Why choose Adalo over other app building solutions? [...] #### Final Verdict

For big enterprises, Betty Blocks provides better on-premise hosting options and greater security compliance than Bubble can. If you're a large organization that needs to build secure apps on your own servers with enterprise-grade compliance, Betty Blocks is the Bubble alternative for you.

However, for most businesses that don't require on-premise hosting, Adalo's modular infrastructure scales to serve apps with over 1 million monthly active users while offering unlimited database records and predictable pricing—enterprise-level performance without enterprise-level complexity or cost.

results.content:
## What is Bubble.io and why you might need Bubble alternatives?

Bubble.io is a popular no-code platform that lets you build full web applications without writing traditional code. You can design interfaces, manage databases, and even handle workflows using a visual editor. It has become a favorite for launching MVPs, testing startup ideas, and building internal tools without needing a dev team.

But the same features that make it great for getting started can also slow you down as your project grows.

Visual editor limitations: At first, Bubble’s drag and drop builder feels empowering. But when you need precise control or want to tweak how something works under the hood, it often turns into a fight with the UI. You end up working around the system instead of with it. [...] Yes, most platforms offer free plans with enough features to test things out. Vitara, Lovable, Glide, FlutterFlow, and Base44 all have usable free tiers.

### How do these Bubble alternatives compare in terms of scalability for a growing business?

Scalability is where many Bubble alternatives start to shine. Tools like Vitara and Wappler let you export and host your own code, so you're not tied to platform limits and can scale infrastructure as needed. Retool and WeWeb are built with growing teams in mind, offering role-based access, performance monitoring, and advanced integrations.
